in_marathi.name: Subhankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Good fortune, auspicious, prosperous
in_marathi.long_meaning: Subhankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Subhankar is a Sanskrit name composed of the words 'subha' meaning good fortune and 'ankar' meaning auspicious or prosperous. This name is believed to bring good fortune and prosperity to the bearer.
